mapper.select: SELECT symbol, name, market, dart_corp_code FROM company WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO financial_report (rcept_no, symbol, bsns_year, reprt_code, fs_div) VALUES (#{rceptNo}, #{symbol}, #{bsnsYear}, #{reprtCode}, #{fsDiv})

INSERT IGNORE INTO financial_value (report_id, account_id, account_nm, thstrm_amount, frmtrm_amount, currency) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{accountId}, #{accountNm}, #{thstrmAmount}, #{frmtrmAmount}, #{currency})
